items.title: Right derived functors of the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves are the cohomology presheaves

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the right derived functors of the inclusion of sheaves into presheaves: they form the cohomology presheaf U -> H^p(U, F) (statement lines 1786-1798). The proof is a definitional computation: left exactness of the forgetful functor is immediate, and after choosing an injective resolution in Mod(O) the derived functors are the cohomology presheaves of the resolution complex, whose sections over U are kernel modulo image of the section complex, which is the definition of H^p(U, F) (proof lines 1801-1812). The content is the identification of a presheaf of sections with a cohomology group, with no further construction. The claim is H2: one definition unfolded carefully.
